description: This plot illustrates the performance changes, measured by $\text{minFDE}_{20}$, of five different methods across varying ratios of an in-context pool. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and follows a linear scale with plotted data ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, featuring numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.2 from 0.2 to 1.0. The y-axis is labeled "$\text{minFDE}_{20} (\downarrow)$" and follows a linear scale ranging from 18 to 23, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 1. The "TrajICL" line is solid blue with circular markers; it begins at a value of approximately 20.45 at an x-axis ratio of 0.1, declines steadily to roughly 18.6 at x=0.5, and continues to decrease more gradually, ending at approximately 18.05 at x=1.0. The "Head Tuning" line is solid orange with circular markers; it starts at approximately 23.0 at x=0.1, fluctuates slightly with a minor peak at approximately 22.9 at x=0.3 and a dip to roughly 22.5 at x=0.9, before ending at approximately 22.6 at x=1.0. The "FT" line is solid green with circular markers; it begins at approximately 22.25 at x=0.1, dips to roughly 21.75 at x=0.2, rises to a local peak of approximately 22.05 at x=0.3, declines to roughly 20.65 at x=0.7, remains steady until x=0.9, and rises to end at approximately 21.0 at x=1.0. The "LoRA 16" line is solid red with circular markers; it starts at approximately 23.0 at x=0.1, remains relatively flat until x=0.2, declines steadily to reach roughly 22.05 at x=0.9, and rises slightly to end at approximately 22.2 at x=1.0. The "LoRA 64" line is solid purple with circular markers; it begins at approximately 22.95 at x=0.1, decreases steadily to roughly 22.1 at x=0.9, and ends with a slight increase at approximately 22.15 at x=1.0.
